_doc: Plugin that declares only sylius/resource-bundle (no sylius/sylius, no sylius/core, no sylius/core-bundle) on a 1.x version — should classify as 1.x. Real-world case: many Setono utility plugins (algolia, image, mailchimp, webhook, etc.) declare only sylius/resource-bundle ^1.6.
